name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest
source:
The story is set in Poland, in the World of Darkness, and has the player take the role of Maia Boroditch, a 24-year-old American woman of Polish descent. She has recurring nightmares of a forest, wolves, and blood, and feels a connection to the forest that drives her to travel to Białowieża in Poland to investigate and learn about her family history. There, she meets the guide Daniel, fellow student Anya, and the local resident Bartek, and explores the Białowieża Forest, one of the last remaining primeval forests in Europe, visiting sacred spots including an ancient burial site, an abandoned wolf den, and a ceremonial place of power.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Werewolf:_The_Apocalypse_%E2%80%93_Heart_of_the_Forest]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
故事以波兰为舞台，采用“黑暗世界”世界观。玩家扮演24岁的波兰裔美国女性玛雅·博罗迪奇。她反复梦见森林、狼与鲜血，冥冥中感到自己与那片森林有所联系，于是前往波兰的比亚沃维耶扎，调查自己的家族历史。在那里，她结识了向导丹尼尔、同为学生的安雅，以及当地居民巴尔特克，并探索比亚沃维耶扎森林。这是欧洲仅存的原始森林之一，其中的神圣地点包括古老的墓地、废弃的狼穴，以及用于仪式的力量之地。

[摘自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Werewolf:_The_Apocalypse_%E2%80%93_Heart_of_the_Forest]维基百科[/url]]
